Specific screen 01: TREASURE CHEST CHOICE on adventure map. Input image is reference for existing game content only, not a design to preserve. Bottom substantial button "Confirm" and quieter button "Decide later". No repeated long text rows, no small generic Choose buttons. Make reward art and quantities the visual focus, a genuinely beautiful compact classic strategy encounter modal.
